$comment: Generated by `bun src/check-registry.ts > schema/check-ids.json` from the checks the code reports; features/rules/contracts.feature fails when this file differs. Every check ID dev-fleet reports: what a passing check means; severity, required (a failure blocks readiness unless the run marks the check out of scope) or advisory (reported as a warning or as not required, never blocking); and repair, the fleet-repair recipe that repairs it or the reason only a person can (manual); requirement, a requirement docs/worker-requirements.md lists. A * stands for a name taken from the fleet configuration, a machine or a tool at run time.
